cohort: 513 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of Debre Markos Referral Hospital between December 1st, 2017 and May 30th, 2018.
finding: Unemployed mothers, not attending antenatal care, not initiating exclusive breastfeeding, neonates admitted due to respiratory distress syndrome, and a severe first minute Apgar score were significantly associated with increased risk of neonatal mortality.
followup_time: Variable, up to the end of the study period (May 30th, 2018)
